scenario.title: Lakeside Water — billing dispute surge (Mock #6, not an official contest problem)
scenario.description: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled in August-September. Customer Service wants an AI agent. Field reading is contracted out; AMI meters and the meter data management system (MDMS) are run by a vendor.
scenario.initial_request: Dispute tickets doubled since August. Build an AI agent that auto-answers billing dispute tickets and fixes whatever is causing the wrong bills.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The dispute response times are well within the SLA (median 1.6 days, p90 2.8 days vs 3‑day SLA). The ticket volume recorded is 2,440 disputes.
Route completion for August‑September 2026 is 0.88, below the target of 0.95, with 9,200 manual read accounts recorded.
No tariff change records were found, indicating that tariff changes are not contributing to the observed wrong bills.
The observation shows that disputed bills are more often associated with actual reads (1785) than estimated reads (1240), indicating that estimation errors are not the primary driver of wrong bills.
Dispute volume rose sharply starting August 2026, roughly doubling compared to June‑July levels (610/590 → 1180/1260).
